changes.title: Evolved: Girls and Panzer Voice Selector (all voices)

previous.changeLog:
Improvements
1. Added the “GuP Voice Selector: Ignore the voices of special crews” option to the Mods menu in the Garage. It works in the same way as the corresponding option at the bottom of Settings → Sound. This provides an alternative way to access the setting in case the option in the game client settings does not appear due to conflicts with other mods.
2. Based on advice from experienced players, the way voice options are integrated into the mod has been improved. Newly added Commanders with their own unique voiceovers can now use their original unique voiceovers normally without having to wait for an update to this mod.
3. Fixed several issues in the Polish subtitle version based on player feedback.
4. Updated the additional voice lines for Alice (by official) so that they better match the story and character context of Girls und Panzer.

current.changeLog:
Bug Fix
1. Fixed an issue where using the official subtitles could cause a drop in game performance.
Improvement
1. For all special crew members unrelated to Girls und Panzer, their additional voice lines—such as reloading voice lines and battlefield communication lines—have been changed from the Girls und Panzer versions back to the default versions to provide a more consistent overall experience.
